skills.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
skills.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff3927|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff1685|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

skills.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
skills.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff1780|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5956|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Soul Splitting Trap
skills.description:
Lay claim to enemy souls, dealing |cffffff4614|r Magic Damage to your target and any other nearby enemies over |cffffff10|r seconds.

Fills an empty Soul Gem if an affected enemy dies.

skills.name: Relentless Focus
skills.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff4|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff4|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff8014|r Disease Damage and heal for |cffffff34|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

skills.name: Replenishing Barrier
skills.description:
Invoke defensive tactics to protect yourself and nearby group members with wards that each absorb up to |cffffff22063|r damage. 

Each time a ward dissolves, you restore |cffffff1500|r Magicka.
